name: da-vinci
description: Universal visual generation skill for Claude Code — images, SVG, videos, audio, and 3D models via OpenAI, Gemini, FAL, KIE, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, and Tripo3D with smart cost gating.

scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ui ci && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.lint: node --check src/generate.mjs && node --check src/utils/*.mjs && node --check src/providers/*.mjs && node --check src/core/*.mjs && node --check src/library/*.mjs
scripts.test:secrets: node -e "import('./src/utils/secrets.mjs').then(m => m.loadSecrets().then(s => console.log('OK. Source:', s.source, 'Keys:', Object.keys(s.secrets))))"

author: Héctor Rodríguez
